# Overview

The following variables will be merged from these datasets to create a Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet

**I. WaDE Synoptic Survey dataset - clean version**

(WaDE_Synoptic_Summary.xlsx)

Variables selected: sample ID, site, date, inherent characteristics, developed land cover, BLM predictors.

**II. BLM Speciation Mode**

Variables selected: free ion, biotic ligand (BL) bound elements, inorganic complexes, and organic element.

-   Zn BLM Speciation Mode (Zn_Speciation.det.xlsx)

-   Cu BLM Speciation Mode (Cu Speciation.det.xlsx)

**III. BLM Toxicity Mode**

Variable from each dataset: concentration of element that causes given toxicity response for the selected organism.

-   Zn BLM Toxicity Mode (Zn Toxicity on C. dubia.det.xlsx)

-   Cu BLM Acute Toxicity Mode on Daphnia (Cu Acute Toxicity on C. dubia.det.xlsx)

-   Cu BLM Chronic Toxicity Mode on Daphnia (Cu Chronic Toxicity on C. dubia.det.xlsx)

-   Cu BLM Acute Toxicity Mode on Minnow (Cu Acute Toxicity on P. promelas.det.xlsx)

-   Cu BLM Chronic Toxicity Mode on Minnow (Cu Chronic Toxicity on P. promelas.det.xlsx)

**IV. BLM Sensitivity Analysis**

Closed system (DIC input) and low humic acid content (10%) (baseline conditions)

Closed system with high humic acid content scenario (80%)

Open System (alkalinity based on charge balance) under low humic acid content (10%)

# WaDE Synoptic Survey

## 1. Variables by Observation

Import WaDE Synoptic Survey dataset "WaDE_SYNOPTIC_SUMMARY" sheet for water sample measurements.

```{r}
library(readxl)

WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/1. Spatial Assessment/Data/Spatial Assessment of Bioavailability Project/1. Running BLM/Data inputs/WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean.xlsx")

head(WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean)
```

Inspect the structure

```{r}
str(WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean)
```

From WaDE_Synoptic_Summary, select sample ID, site, date, and BLM predictors

```{r}
library(dplyr)

bio_ms <- WaDE_Synoptic_Summary_Clean %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample_ID,
    Site,
    Date,
    Regime,
    Flow_state,
    pH,
    Temp_C,
    DOC_uM,
    Ca_uM,
    Mg_uM,
    Na_uM,
    K_uM,
    SO4_uM,
    Cl_uM,
    DIC_uM,
    Zn_uM,
    Cu_uM
         )

# check
head(bio_ms)
```

## 2. Variables by Site

Import WaDE Synoptic Survey dataset "SITE_INFO" sheet for inherent characteristics and developed land use by site.

```{r}
library(readxl)

WaDE_Site_Info <- read_excel("C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/1. Spatial Assessment/Data/Spatial Assessment of Bioavailability Project/1. Running BLM/Data inputs/WaDE_Synoptic_Summary.xlsx", 
    sheet = "SITE INFO")

head(WaDE_Site_Info)
```

Inspect the structure

```{r}
str(WaDE_Site_Info)
```

From WaDE_Site_Info we'll select network, regime, elevation, upstream distance from main stem, drainage area, developed land cover by site and apply it to all samples by site

```{r}
library(dplyr)

bio_ms <- bio_ms %>%
  left_join(
    WaDE_Site_Info %>%
      rename(
        Relative_elevation_m = `Elevation relative to EFK (m)`,
        Dist_from_EFPC_km    = `Upstream of EFK_KM`,
        Drainage_area_km2    = `DrainageArea_SqKm`,
        Developed_lulc       = `lulc_developed_%`
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Site,
        Network,
        Relative_elevation_m,
        Dist_from_EFPC_km,
        Drainage_area_km2,
        Developed_lulc
      ),
    by = "Site"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Relative_elevation_m = as.numeric(Relative_elevation_m),
    Dist_from_EFPC_km    = as.numeric(Dist_from_EFPC_km),
    Drainage_area_km2    = as.numeric(Drainage_area_km2),
    Developed_lulc       = as.numeric(Developed_lulc)
  )

# check
head(bio_ms)
```

Inspect the structure again

```{r}
str(bio_ms)
```

# BLM Speciation Mode

Using the output excel workbooks ending in .det (meaning detailed), we convert them to the newest Excel Workbook version before importing them.

## 1. Merge **Zn Variables**

Import dataset

```{r}
library(readxl)
Zn_Speciation_det <- read_excel(
  "C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/1. Spatial Assessment/Data/Spatial Assessment of Bioavailability Project/1. Running BLM/Data outputs/Zinc/Speciation Mode/Zn Speciation.det.xlsx"
)

head(Zn_Speciation_det)
```

Clean dataset

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

Zn_Speciation_det_clean <- Zn_Speciation_det %>%
  # 1) Drop rows 1–3
  slice(-(1:3)) %>%
  
  # 2) Set first remaining row as column names
  { 
    nm <- as.character(.[1, ])
    nm <- make.unique(nm)
    out <- .[-1, ]
    names(out) <- nm
    out
  } %>%
  
  # 3) Remove units row (now the first row)
  slice(-1) %>%
  
  # 4) Rename ID columns
  rename(
    Sample_ID = `Site Label`,
    Site      = `Sample Label`
  ) %>%
  
  # 5) Clean Sample_ID and convert others to numeric
  mutate(
    Sample_ID = str_extract(Sample_ID, "WaDE_\\d+"),
    across(-c(Sample_ID, Site), ~ as.numeric(str_replace_all(.x, '"', "")))
  )


# Preview
head(Zn_Speciation_det_clean)

# Sanity check: make sure Sample_ID matches to that of the Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet called bio_ms (should be 386)

bio_ms %>%
  inner_join(
    Zn_Speciation_det_clean %>% 
      dplyr::select(Sample_ID),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  summarise(n_matched = n())
```

Select variables and add to bio_ms

```{r}
library(dplyr)

bio_ms_ha10_cs <- bio_ms %>%
  left_join(
    Zn_Speciation_det_clean %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        Free_Zn_M        = Zn,          # free Zn
        ZnOH_M           = ZnOH,
        Zn_OH_2_M        = `Zn(OH)2`,
        ZnCO3_M          = ZnCO3,
        ZnHCO3_M         = ZnHCO3,
        ZnSO4_M          = ZnSO4,
        ZnCl_M           = ZnCl,
        ZnS_M            = ZnS,
        TOrg_Zn_M        = TOrg.Zn,
        BL_Zn_mol_kg_Zn    = `BL-Zn`,  # suffix _Zn indicating Zn-BLM
        BL_Ca_mol_kg_Zn    = `BL-Ca`,
        BL_H_mol_kg_Zn     = `BL-H`,
        BL_Mg_mol_kg_Zn    = `BL-Mg`,
        BL_Na_mol_kg_Zn    = `BL-Na`,
        BL_ZnOH_mol_kg_Zn  = `BL-ZnOH`
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Sample_ID,
        Free_Zn_M,
        ZnOH_M,
        Zn_OH_2_M,
        ZnCO3_M,
        ZnHCO3_M,
        ZnSO4_M,
        ZnCl_M,
        ZnS_M,
        TOrg_Zn_M,
        BL_Zn_mol_kg_Zn,
        BL_Ca_mol_kg_Zn,
        BL_H_mol_kg_Zn,
        BL_Mg_mol_kg_Zn,
        BL_Na_mol_kg_Zn,
        BL_ZnOH_mol_kg_Zn
      ),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  )

# Make sure they're numeric
zn_new_vars <- c(
  "ZnOH_M", "Zn_OH_2_M", "ZnSO4_M", "ZnCO3_M", "ZnHCO3_M", "ZnS_M", "ZnCl_M",
  "Free_Zn_M", "Zn_OH_2_M", "TOrg_Zn_M",
  "BL_Zn_mol_kg_Zn", "BL_Ca_mol_kg_Zn", "BL_H_mol_kg_Zn",
  "BL_Mg_mol_kg_Zn", "BL_Na_mol_kg_Zn", "BL_ZnOH_mol_kg_Zn"
)

# Convert them to numeric
bio_ms_ha10_cs <- bio_ms_ha10_cs %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(zn_new_vars), ~ as.numeric(.)))

# Check
str(bio_ms_ha10_cs)
```

```{r}
library(openxlsx)

file_path <- "Bioavailability_Master_Spreadsheet.xlsx"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Create workbook if file does NOT exist

if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
  
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb, "HA 10% Closed System")
  writeData(wb, "HA 10% Closed System", bio_ms_ha10_cs)
  saveWorkbook(wb, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)

} else {

  # 2. If the file EXISTS, load it and add/overwrite the sheet

  wb <- loadWorkbook(file_path)

    addWorksheet(wb, "HA 10% Closed System")
  }

}
```

Import dataset

```{r}

  "C:/Users/q4q/OneDrive - Oak Ridge National Laboratory/Research/Bioavailability Project/1. Spatial Assessment/Data/Spatial Assessment of Bioavailability Project/1. Running BLM/Data outputs/Zinc/Speciation Mode/Zn Speciation_ha80.det.xlsx"
)

head(Zn_Speciation_ha80)
```

Data cleaning

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

Zn_Speciation_ha80_clean <- Zn_Speciation_ha80 %>%
  # 1) Drop rows 1–3
  slice(-(1:3)) %>%
  
  # 2) Set first remaining row as column names (and make them unique)
  {
    nm <- as.character(.[1, ])
    nm <- make.unique(nm)
    out <- .[-1, ]
    names(out) <- nm
    out
  } %>%
  
  # 3) Remove units row (now the first row)
  slice(-1) %>%
  
  # 4) Rename ID columns
  rename(
    Sample_ID = `Site Label`,
    Site      = `Sample Label`
  ) %>%
  
  # 5) Clean Sample_ID + strip quotes + convert everything else to numeric
  mutate(
    Sample_ID = str_extract(Sample_ID, "WaDE_\\d+"),
    across(-c(Sample_ID, Site), ~ as.numeric(str_replace_all(.x, '"', "")))
  )

# Preview
head(Zn_Speciation_ha80_clean)

# Sanity check: match count vs Bioavailability Master Spreadsheet (bio_ms)
bio_ms %>%
  inner_join(
    Zn_Speciation_ha80_clean %>% dplyr::select(Sample_ID),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  summarise(n_matched = dplyr::n())

```
